This week's AirPods Pro 3 25% discount is continuing, AirPods Max 2 is $120 off across all five colors, the AirTag 2 all-time low is also still going, but today's 9to5Toys Lunch Break also has several new deals to flag. If you're quick, the official Apple Refurbished store has restocked the cheapest 13-inch M5 MacBook Pro at $1,099 in Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue, and we're also tracking a batch of brand-new M5 Pro MacBook Pro deals at $400 off. The Apple Watch Series 11 $100 discount is also back with prices starting at just over $250, and we also have Twelve South accessory deals – its Find My charger and Curve Nano MagSafe stand are both at new Amazon lows. Keep reading for all the details.

AirPods deals drop further with up to $120 off: AirPods Pro 3 25% off, more

After a summer of steady Apple AirPods deals on the latest releases, nearly every model is down even further. The wildly popular AirPods Pro 3 are now at one of their best prices ever at 25% off, the ANC-equipped AirPods 4 have also dropped to their lowest price in months, and the AirPods Max 2 are down even further this morning to $120 off.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $190 (regular $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $429 (regular $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (regular $129)

AirTag 2 back down to one of its all-time lows from $22 (4-pack and single)

  • AirTag 2 $24 (regular $29) | Amazon
  • AirTag 2 $24 (regular $29) | Best Buy
  • AirTag 2 'Premium' open-box $20 (regular new $29) | Best Buy
  • AirTag 2 4-pack $89 (regular $99)

Best Buy takes anniversary LG deals live for one day only: TVs from $330, 2026 OLED models $600 off, more

Restocked: Cheapest M5 MacBook Air available from Apple Refurbished at $1,099, act fast (new model on sale $200 off)

Update 8/20: This deal has now been restocked, with Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue all at $1,099.

This deal likely won't last long – they never do – but the official Apple Refurbished store has now restocked the most affordable 13-inch M5 MacBook Pro at $1,099 with shipping, in Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue.

This particular configuration sells out fast every time it comes back in stock, so don't hesitate if you're interested – this is the cheapest price we've ever seen on the M5 MacBook Air.

The official Apple Certified Refurbished store is now offering the 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB RAM and 512GB storage for $1,099 with shipping. As mentioned above, Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue are available at the time of writing.

That's $200 off the new model MSRP of $1,299.

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,099 (new MSRP $1,299)
  • Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue

Just a reminder that everything from the official Apple Refurbished store comes with the following coverage:

  • Apple 1-year limited warranty
  • Apple 14-day return policy
  • Eligible for AppleCare purchase
  • Rigorous refurbishment process before sale

For comparison, Amazon's pricing on this new model is very close to the $1,299 MSRP, with the Silver model at $1,240.

Amazon still has M5 Pro MacBook Pro configs on sale at $400 off

As part of its 60th Anniversary event, Best Buy held a special one-day Apple sale yesterday. The highlights were two M5 Pro MacBook Pro configurations at $400 off; if you missed it, Amazon still has both configurations on sale today.

Amazon is still offering these two 14-inch 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro configurations at $400 off MSRP – one with the base CPU/GPU specs and another bumped up to an 18-core/12-core setup.

  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,599 (regular $2,999) 15-core CPU and 16-core GPU
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,799 (regular $3,199) 18-core CPU and 20-core GPU

These are indeed the same deals we featured yesterday, but they look like they may only last a day – Best Buy said as much, and there's no telling if Amazon will follow suit. In any case, Amazon could end these deals at any time, but as of writing they're still live, and we wanted to make sure you didn't miss out on them.

This 48GB 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro is $400 off today

B&H is now offering the 14-inch Apple M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 48GB RAM and 1TB storage for $2,699 with shipping.

That's $400 off the regular $3,099 configuration and a $400 savings compared to buying directly from Apple.

Apple Watch Series 11 anniversary week $100 off, Best Buy open-box from $254

While yesterday's 24-hour 60th Anniversary Apple sale has ended, there are still plenty of deals to be had. That includes 25% off AirPods Pro 3, $120 off AirPods Max 2, and the return of the all-time low on Apple's latest AirTag 2; we're also seeing all of the cheapest Apple Watch Series 11 models down $100 at Amazon and Best Buy, with 'Premium' open-box deals from $254.

Amazon is once again offering all base 46mm Series 11 models at $329 with shipping. That's $100 off the $429 MSRP, with all four case colors now at the discounted price.

However, the smaller and cheaper 42mm model is now almost completely out of stock. That's where Best Buy comes in.

Best Buy is in the middle of its big 60th anniversary this week, and all 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 models are in stock and on sale at $100 off MSRP.

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (regular $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (regular $429)

While the price difference isn't huge, we'd also flag the 'Premium' open-box deal on the Jet Black 42mm model – you can land one for $253.99 with shipping, which is $145 off the new MSRP. Compared to the $45 savings buying new right now, that $45 is nothing to sneeze at, and it's the lowest price we can find from a reputable retailer.

Amazon's best Premium Renewed iPhone 17 Pro models down $220 today (Prime Day comp)

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,279 (new MSRP $1,499)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,279 (new MSRP $1,499)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,279 (new MSRP $1,499)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,179 (new MSRP $1,299)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,179 (new MSRP $1,299)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,179 (new MSRP $1,299)

As detailed in yesterday's Apple Refurbished Store roundup, you can land an iPhone 16 with 1-year Apple warranty starting from $699, as well as a 1TB 16 Pro Max for $1,129—saving you up to $330 over the comparable 17 Pro Max and $130 over the 512GB 17 Pro.

  • Refurbished iPhone 16 from $699 (up to $330 cheaper than 17 series)

Twelve South Curve Nano is one of the most beautiful MagSafe stands I've seen, now $27 (regular $35)

Today's accessories and charger deals:

  • Twelve South's full-feature braided PowerCord USB-C charger drops to $16.50 (45% off)
  • 5TB for $180? Rare deal drops WD Elements external HDD to its lowest price since the price hike (today only)
  • Woot's latest deals: Keychron mechanical keyboards from $20, up to 64% off
  • This 14-in-1 Anker Prime docking station is $100 off, one of its lowest prices ever
  • This Anker 8-outlet power strip with USB and surge protection is $22 today
  • Upgrade your home theater reactive lighting experience with the Govee TV Backlight 3 Lite kit for $110, other models from $60
  • Monitor your pet with 360-degree views and two-way talk on the Petcube Cam 360, now $35
  • Govee's latest Floor Lamp 3 Lite (Matter support) falls to $85, other models from $80, up to 47% off
  • Anker Nano 100W three-output charger with 5-foot cable is $36 today

Amazon has AirPods Max 2 $120 off across all five colors (one of the best prices ever)

This week's big 60th anniversary event has brought one of the best prices ever on Apple's 2026 AirPods Max 2, with Amazon offering all five colors at $120 off MSRP.

Amazon is now offering the Apple AirPods Max 2 for $429 with shipping.

That's $120 off the same $549 MSRP as the previous generation, and it's the best price we can find on a new unit from a reputable retailer right now.

Best Buy does have the Midnight color 'Premium' open-box for $403.99 with shipping, which is a bit cheaper, but arguably not worth giving up a new unit for a small savings.

Apple released a true next-generation AirPods Max this year, not just a new shell and USB-C port. Unlike the in-ear AirPods lineup, next month's product announcements won't be updating its over-ear offering, so this week's $120 discount might be the lowest price for Apple's newest and best over-ear headphones for some time.

The only sale event to deliver a lower price before now was Prime Day earlier this summer, when prices dropped an additional $30 below today's deal – but stock was very limited and inconsistent over the four-day event.

Anker 45W Nano smart display charger holds at $26 low, but this time it comes with a USB-C cable for just $4 more

As part of its ongoing 60th anniversary event, Best Buy is offering the white Anker 45W Nano smart display charger with Nano USB-C cable bundle for $29.99 with shipping. That's about $4 more than the charger's current discounted price of $25.99 with shipping at Amazon and Best Buy. Considering the included Nano USB-C cable normally sells for around $18, this effectively means you're getting the cable for just $4, which is a great deal. Keep reading for more details.

  • Anker Nano 45W GaN Smart Display Charger $25.99 (regular $40)
  • Black
  • Blue
  • Orange
  • White

The Anker 45W Nano charger features a built-in smart display that can identify supported devices like iPhone and iPad Pro and adjust power delivery accordingly. The screen also displays real-time charging info and animations, so you can see the charging status at a glance. It features a single top-mounted USB-C port with up to 45W output, plus 180-degree folding prongs for everyday use or travel. Anker offers it in four colors, including an orange that pairs nicely with Apple's Cosmic Orange devices. This particular listing bundles the charger with an Anker Nano USB-C cable for just $4 more. The braided cable supports up to 240W charging and 480Mb/s data transfer, making it a solid overall pick and a great deal if you're looking for a new reliable charging cable.

Other Anker deals worth a look

  • Anker Prime 25W Qi2.2 3-in-1 MagSafe foldable charger $100 (regular $150)
  • Anker Prime 3-in-1 25W Qi2.2 charging station with display $135 (regular $230)
  • Anker 160W 3-output Prime charger with display and touch controls $116 (regular $150)
